model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for four different methods. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", has a linear scale with a value range of approximately 2 to 11, units of AL, and tick labels at regular intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", has a linear scale with a value range of 25 to 33, units of BLEU score, and tick labels at regular intervals of 1. The plot contains four lines: Consistency-CE (purple, dashed), Inconsistency-CE (maroon, dashed), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue, dashed), and Consistency-Bi (red, solid with star markers). The Consistency-Bi line starts at approximately (2.5, 29) and ends at (11, 32), showing an upward trend. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line starts at approximately (2.5, 26.5) and ends at (11, 31.5), also showing an upward trend. The Inconsistency-CE line starts at approximately (2.5, 26) and ends at (11, 31), and the Consistency-CE line starts at approximately (2.5, 26) and ends at (11, 31), both lines exhibiting a similar upward trend.
